🚨 𝐒𝐲𝐝𝐧𝐞𝐲 𝐓𝐞𝐫𝐫𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐦 𝐂𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐁𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧‼️

Two terrorists, a father–son duo, carried out a terrorist attack in Sydney, killing Jews who were celebrating Hanukkah. 

In the immediate aftermath, the I dian, Israelis and Afghans falsely blamed Pakistan. A few hours later, it was established that the terrorists did not belong to Pakistan but to India, and connections with ISIS-Daesh were established. 

Recent visits to the Philippines added more fuel to the fire, and a new Pandora’s box was opened.

Fifteen years ago, Nepalese intelligence broke a story that India’s National Security Advisor Ajit Kumar Doval tricked the Syrian ambassador to India, Raed Kamal Abbas, and took the entire database of ISIS-Daesh fighters and warlords, and then established official connections with the fighters and terrorists of Daesh. 

Multiple trips by Doval to Syria can be found using Open Source Intelligence after 2014.

Now the Philippines is in play. The Philippines has significant Chinese influence, and Indians need to sell weapons to the Philippines. To counter China’s and Pakistan’s interests, they established ISIS-Daesh strongholds inside the Philippines by supporting the Abu Sayyaf (ISIS) group and the Maute terrorist organizations. 

Now the dots are connected.

The Indian state is officially in touch with ISIS. The Philippines is a playground for ISIS, and all these dots are now connected and collaborating. 

You can see that the presence of the Indian state cannot be ruled out in the terrorist activity that took place in Australia. India has a history of attacking Sikhs in Australia as well.
